title: 建築エンジニアリング総合演習A
subtitle: Architectural Integrated Exercises for engineering A
keywords: Thermal, air, light environments 2.Psychological/ environmental design 3.Loading test 4.Compression test
educationalGoal: Students will conduct comprehensive exercises in the structural and environmental fields of architecture. They will learn the technology and design skills to realize living spaces that are environmentally friendly and comfortable, as well as safe and secure.
advice: Course work for experiments and exercises by learning area: [Structural experiments] ・Concrete production and compressive strength testing ・Reinforcing bar tensile tests ・Static loading test of truss structures ・Wood compression experiments [Environmental experiments] ・Measurement and evaluation of solar radiation ・Landscape evaluation ・Measurement and evaluation of odor and airborne substances ・Proposal and evaluation of thermal/light environments Credits will not be awarded unless all report assignments are submitted. Lateness or absences carry great point deductions.
requiredKnowledge: Actively prepare for each theme and discover issues to consider. Review the subjects taken in the first and second years. Experiment with clothes that are safe to work in. Bring a personal computer, notebook, and writing instrument for data reduction.

activityGoals.body: Students can explain various architectural phenomena through experiments and exercises.
Students can analyze data on various phenomena related to structures and the architectural environment.
Students can create logical, objective, and easy-to-understand reports based on experimental results.
Students have a positive attitude toward class. They keep strict deadlines with no late arrivals nor absences.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
 ※学習課題の時間欄には、指定された学習課題に要する標準的な時間を記載してあります。日々の自学自習時間全体としては、各授業に応じた時間(例えば2単位科目の場合、予習2時間・復習2時間/週)を取るよう努めてください。詳しくは教員の指導に従って
